options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: local_media_support
options.description: To enable or disable Local Media Support,check or uncheck the checkbox respectively. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: mount
options.description: Whether to mount virtual media. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: mount_type
options.description: Virtual mount type. The I(FD) option is not supported in M6.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: remote_domain_name
options.description: Remote Domain Name,Domain Name field is optional.

options.name: remote_media_support
options.description: To enable or disable Remote Media support,check or uncheck the checbox respectively.

options.name: remote_server_address
options.description: Address of the server where the remote media images are stored.

options.name: remote_share_type
options.description: Share Type of the remote media server either NFS or Samba(CIFS).

options.name: remote_source_path
options.description: Source path to the remote media images..

options.name: remote_user_name
options.description: Remote User Name. Required when I(remote_share_type=cifs).

options.name: same_settings
options.description: Same settings with CD,0 is No,1 is Yes. Required when I(mount_type=0).

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
